title: API Acre
description: 47 x402-paid web, document, research, developer, data, and EVM tools on Base, plus free workflows.
summary: 47 x402-paid web, document, research, developer, data, and EVM tools on Base, plus free workflows.
offersHint: 47 x402-paid web, document, research, developer, data, and EVM tools on Base, plus free workflows. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://apiacre.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: web.extract
toolsPreview.description: Extract clean readable text or Markdown from a public web page with redirect, response, content-hash, and extraction provenance for research, RAG, or agent context.

toolsPreview.name: web.metadata
toolsPreview.description: Extract an agent-ready public-page metadata record with redirects, response provenance, canonical and alternate URLs, headings, icons, feeds, social cards, Schema.org types, and privacy-safe publisher-asserted Organization facts with field evidence.

toolsPreview.name: web.seo-audit
toolsPreview.description: Audit on-page technical SEO, score a public URL, and return prioritized, actionable issues for search optimization.

toolsPreview.name: web.security-audit
toolsPreview.description: Scan a public website for TLS and browser security header weaknesses and return a security score with fixes.

toolsPreview.name: web.accessibility-audit
toolsPreview.description: Check a public page for deterministic HTML accessibility problems and return actionable WCAG-oriented findings.

toolsPreview.name: web.performance-profile
toolsPreview.description: Measure website response latency, payload size, compression, caching, and performance signals for a public URL.

toolsPreview.name: web.links
toolsPreview.description: Extract and classify links from one public page or safely crawl up to 10 same-origin pages into an agent-ready site map with page provenance, depth limits, and robots.txt enforcement.

toolsPreview.name: web.robots-sitemap
toolsPreview.description: Inspect a domain's robots.txt crawl rules and XML sitemap health, availability, and URL count.

toolsPreview.name: web.tech-fingerprint
toolsPreview.description: Identify frameworks, analytics, CDNs, servers, and other website technologies from public response signals.

toolsPreview.name: web.domain-intelligence
toolsPreview.description: Investigate a domain using parallel DNS, TLS certificate, RDAP, DNSSEC, SPF, and DMARC signals with factual findings and source provenance.

toolsPreview.name: web.full-audit
toolsPreview.description: Run a comprehensive website audit combining SEO, security, accessibility, and performance scores with prioritized fixes.

toolsPreview.name: web.business-due-diligence
toolsPreview.description: Assess a business domain using website quality, SEO, security, accessibility, performance, DNS, TLS, RDAP, and optional public GLEIF LEI entity candidates.

toolsPreview.name: research.lei-entity-search
toolsPreview.description: Search the official GLEIF Global LEI Index by exact LEI or legal name and return ranked legal-entity identity, registration, mapped-identifier, and relationship-availability evidence.

toolsPreview.name: document.extract
toolsPreview.description: Extract clean text and metadata from supplied PDF, DOCX, HTML, Markdown, CSV, JSON, YAML, or plain-text documents.

toolsPreview.name: document.tables
toolsPreview.description: Extract structured table rows and columns from supplied HTML, DOCX, or CSV documents.

toolsPreview.name: document.redact
toolsPreview.description: Detect and redact PII and personal data in text, including email addresses, phone numbers, IPv4 addresses, payment cards, and US Social Security numbers.

toolsPreview.name: document.diff
toolsPreview.description: Compare two texts and return structured line additions, removals, and a unified diff.

toolsPreview.name: data.profile
toolsPreview.description: Profile CSV, JSON, or YAML records for field types, nulls, uniqueness, and representative samples.

toolsPreview.name: data.clean
toolsPreview.description: Clean CSV, JSON, or YAML records by normalizing keys, trimming whitespace, and standardizing empty values.

toolsPreview.name: data.convert
toolsPreview.description: Convert structured data between CSV, JSON, and YAML formats with a machine-readable response.

toolsPreview.name: data.schema
toolsPreview.description: Infer a nested JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 contract from CSV, JSON, or YAML, including required fields, mixed and nullable types, array items, object properties, input evidence, and non-enforcing observed bounds.

toolsPreview.name: data.schema-validate
toolsPreview.description: Validate caller-supplied JSON against a bounded JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 contract with deterministic error pointers, format checks, input fingerprints, and no remote reference resolution.

toolsPreview.name: data.schemaorg-normalize
toolsPreview.description: Normalize caller-supplied inline Schema.org JSON-LD into deterministic Organization, Product, Service, Article, and Event entities with privacy scrubbing and field-level evidence hashes.

toolsPreview.name: data.deduplicate
toolsPreview.description: Remove duplicate CSV, JSON, or YAML records using selected identity fields and report the removed count.

toolsPreview.name: developer.x402-preflight
toolsPreview.description: Probe a public endpoint without paying and return an x402 v2 compliance grade, protocol evidence, and actionable remediation.

toolsPreview.name: developer.openapi-audit
toolsPreview.description: Validate and audit an OpenAPI document for missing operation IDs, descriptions, responses, and consistency problems.

toolsPreview.name: developer.dependency-audit
toolsPreview.description: Audit exact Python/PyPI, npm, Go, Maven, NuGet, crates.io, or RubyGems dependencies against OSV and return affected packages and vulnerabilities.

toolsPreview.name: developer.license-audit
toolsPreview.description: Classify software dependency licenses and flag packages that need commercial or legal review.

toolsPreview.name: developer.secret-scan
toolsPreview.description: Scan source code or configuration text for leaked API keys, tokens, and credentials without returning secret values.

toolsPreview.name: developer.code-metrics
toolsPreview.description: Measure caller-supplied source code with Python AST analysis or a deterministic lexical fallback, including per-function complexity, a SHA-256 fingerprint, density ratios, syntax status, and actionable maintainability signals without retaining or forwarding the code.

toolsPreview.name: developer.sql-change-review
toolsPreview.description: Statically parse caller-supplied SQL without a database connection or execution, inventory statements and tables, and flag destructive DDL, unfiltered writes, and migration atomicity concerns.

toolsPreview.name: developer.structured-diff
toolsPreview.description: Compare JSON or YAML deterministically and return source hashes plus machine-readable additions, removals, and replacements by path with explicit truncation evidence.

toolsPreview.name: research.feed-normalize
toolsPreview.description: Fetch and normalize public RSS or Atom feeds into stable structured JSON entries for agents and research workflows.

toolsPreview.name: research.news-aggregate
toolsPreview.description: Merge two to eight public RSS or Atom feeds into a filtered, deduplicated, time-ordered news stream with bounded partial-failure reporting.

toolsPreview.name: developer.openapi-test-generate
toolsPreview.description: Generate deterministic, syntax-validated pytest and requests smoke tests from a caller-supplied OpenAPI 3 document, with mutating operations disabled by default.

toolsPreview.name: research.sec-filing-signals
toolsPreview.description: Look up a public company by ticker or CIK, normalize recent SEC filings, and flag deterministic events such as late filings, amendments, auditor changes, non-reliance, control changes, or bankruptcy disclosures.

toolsPreview.name: research.sec-insider-transactions
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve recent SEC Form 4 officer, director, and 10% beneficial-owner trades for a ticker or CIK, including purchases, sales, awards, exercises, tax withholding, prices, holdings, 10b5-1 context, derivatives, and filing footnotes.

toolsPreview.name: research.sec-financial-facts
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve normalized, recent issuer-reported revenue, earnings, balance-sheet, cash-flow, and diluted-EPS facts from official SEC XBRL data.

toolsPreview.name: crypto.address-inspect
toolsPreview.description: Validate and normalize an Ethereum or EVM wallet address, distinguish valid, absent, or invalid ERC-55 checksum casing, and identify the zero address without a network request.

toolsPreview.name: crypto.base-account-snapshot
toolsPreview.description: Read point-in-time ETH, native USDC, and up to four caller-selected ERC-20 balances plus account nonce and contract-code status at one resolved Base mainnet block.

toolsPreview.name: crypto.base-account-status
toolsPreview.description: Read ETH balance, transaction nonce, and contract-code evidence for one address at a single resolved Base mainnet block.

toolsPreview.name: crypto.base-network-status
toolsPreview.description: Read the latest Base mainnet block and a bounded EIP-1559 fee history in one RPC batch, including gas utilization and priority-fee percentile samples.

toolsPreview.name: crypto.base-contract-inspect
toolsPreview.description: Inspect Base mainnet contract bytecode, common token metadata, and ERC-165, ERC-721, and ERC-1155 interface signals at one resolved block.

toolsPreview.name: crypto.base-contract-read
toolsPreview.description: Execute one bounded read-only eth_call against a resolved Base mainnet block, retain call and block evidence, and optionally decode caller-specified ABI output types.

toolsPreview.name: crypto.base-transaction-inspect
toolsPreview.description: Inspect a Base mainnet transaction and receipt together, including execution outcome, confirmations, actual fee, recognized calldata, and bounded ERC-20-shaped transfer events with official Base USDC recognition.

toolsPreview.name: crypto.calldata-decode
toolsPreview.description: Resolve 29 common ERC-20, ERC-165, ERC-721, ERC-1155, ERC-2612, and ERC-3009 selectors without a network lookup, or strictly decode arbitrary Ethereum or EVM calldata using a supplied Solidity signature.

toolsPreview.name: crypto.typed-data-hash
toolsPreview.description: Validate EIP-712 typed structured data and derive its domain separator, message hash, and signing digest.
